learningOutcome.reason: The correction item did not pass, so lesson promotion stopped.
learningOutcome.truthBoundary: Improvement means one failed baseline concept was later passed on a different held-out item after a gated retrieval pack. It does not prove broad or durable math improvement.

openGaps: More held-out items and repeated sessions are required to establish durable transfer.
One bounded lesson cannot establish broad domain competence.
truthBoundary: Observed scores and a bounded retest support only the named item/concept claims; they do not prove general expertise or durable model-level learning.
